claim.claim-text: 2. The absorbent article of claim 1, wherein the polyolefin content comprises at least 95% by weight, based on the total weight of the absorbent article excluding the core absorbent material.

3. The absorbent article of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the polyolefin content comprises at least 99% by weight, based on the total weight of the absorbent article excluding the core absorbent material.
4. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the bio-based content of the superabsorbent polymers comprises from 10% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.
5. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the bio-based content of the superabsorbent polymers comprises from 90% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.
6. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the core absorbent material comprises at least 60% by weight of the superabsorbent polymers.
7. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the core absorbent material is substantially free of absorbent pulp.
8. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the core absorbent material further comprises an absorbent pulp.
9. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the topsheet comprises a bio-based polyolefin with a bio-based content from 5% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.
10. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the topsheet comprises a bio-based polyolefin with a bio-based content from 75% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.
11. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the backsheet comprises a bio-based polyolefin with a bio-based content from 5% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.
12. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the backsheet comprises a bio-based polyolefin with a bio-based content from 75% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.
13. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein:

14. The absorbent article of claim 13, wherein the at least one of the nonwoven topsheet, the backsheet film, the backsheet nonwoven web, the landing zone, the stretch ear film, the back ear nonwoven web, the tape tabs, the ear hooks, the front ear nonwoven web, the waist feature nonwoven web, the waist feature elastics, the barrier leg cuff nonwoven web, the outer leg elastics, the acquisition material, the core cover nonwoven web, the chassis adhesives, or the core adhesives that comprises at least 50% by weight of polyolefin comprises a bio-based polyolefin with a bio-based content from 5% to 100% using ASTM D6866-10, method B.

15. The absorbent article according to any preceding claim, wherein the polyolefin comprises one or more of low density polyethylene, high density polyethylene, linear low density polyethylene, a propylene homopolymer, an ethylene copolymer, or a propylene copolymer or one or more blends thereof.
